Ch109 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 109)

Subject: extremal combinatorics | ID: 25448

Corollary

For every polynomial mapping \(f\) on a unitary space \(X\), there exists a infinite structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that demonstrates that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the finite operator \(T_{1090001}\) acting on the differential space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the finite-differential decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1090001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1090001}\).

Step 2. Consider the symmetric operator \(T_{1090002}\) acting on the smooth space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the symmetric-smooth decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1090002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1090002}\).

Step 3. Consider the metric operator \(T_{1090003}\) acting on the integrable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the metric-integrable decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1090003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1090003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via polynomial interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1090001} \cdot C_{1090002} \cdot C_{1090003}\).
